description: Authenticity over likability every single time #authenticity #bigsisteradvice #PersonalGrowth
transcript: Details matter. I can remember vividly when the rug has been pulled from underneath me. I can remember when doors have been slammed in my face. I can remember when there was six candy bars and I was the seventh person that didn't get one. These moments have been such a gift because they have pushed me closer to myself. The closer that I get to myself, I have realized that I do not chase validation and I don't have to. I don't have to chase like ability. It does not matter what I do or how I do it. If a space does not want my presence, the space will never accept me being there and that's okay. Acceptance comes from me. That is who I have to look at in the mirror at the end of the day. And this life is about getting me to the other side, not focusing and worrying about where others want me. I want me.
